faq.q: What does the GTA 6 Standard Edition include?
faq.a: It is the base purchase of Grand Theft Auto VI, giving full access to the story campaign for both protagonists, Jason and Lucia, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. It does not include the extra vehicles, weapons or side missions bundled with the Ultimate Edition.

faq.q: How much does the GTA 6 Standard Edition cost?
faq.a: It is priced at 79.99 USD in the United States, with equivalent pricing confirmed in the UK, India, Canada, Australia and the Eurozone. This was confirmed in a Rockstar Newswire post on 24 June 2026.

faq.q: Can Standard Edition owners upgrade to the Ultimate Edition later?
faq.a: Yes. Standard Edition owners can purchase the Ultimate Edition Upgrade separately at any time, including after launch, so buying Standard first does not lock anyone out of the extra content.

faq.q: Does pre-ordering the GTA 6 Standard Edition come with any bonuses?
faq.a: Anyone who pre-orders the Standard Edition before 20 November 2026 receives the Vintage Vice City pack. Digital pre-orders also come with one free month of GTA+.

faq.q: Will the GTA 6 Standard Edition price stay the same after the pre-order period ends?
faq.a: Rockstar has not said. The record confirms the 79.99 USD price and the pre-order bonuses, but says nothing about pricing or promotions after 20 November 2026.

notKnown: Whether the 79.99 USD price changes after the pre-order period ends on 20 November 2026.

howWeKnow: This entry comes from a Rockstar Newswire post published on 24 June 2026, an official first-party source rather than a press report or community sighting. Rockstar used that post to confirm pricing, platforms and the pre-order bonus terms for Grand Theft Auto VI directly.
